name: GTA1 cleaned grounding dataset
notes: Hub revision 5c0836a5 lists the card, inp.json and ten split image archive parts (image.part.aa to image.part.aj); the repository is not gated and has no card metadata. The card describes desktop and web grounding sources and names no paper; the GTA1 repository README links this repository as GTA1's training data and cleaned dataset, which supports the paper relation. Salesforce later published a separate grounding release with a different field schema and more source datasets; this record covers only this upload. The license comes from the GTA1 README.
summary: Cleaned GUI grounding training data linked by the GTA1 repository, drawn mainly from Aria-UI and OS-Atlas, with samples dropped when the target box and an OmniParser-detected element differ.
